status: Read-only original-source review complete; avoid robot selection/console in differential captures; source predictions only

recommendation.preferred: Keep loaded robfocus0. Use toolbar keycycle for9 separate single-cycle clicks from nativecounter1 to10, save; then90 clicks to100, save. Do not click robot/world selection, Ctrl+B/FindBest or Open Console between captures.
recommendation.reason: This avoids extra hit-test/render compensation, focus/highlight changes and accidental drag. It adds no new original helper/app dependency.
recommendation.scope_limit: It avoids selection-specific mutation. Toolbar cycle still performs the original UpdateSim→Redraw behavior. Do not describe all rendering as bit-perfect nonmutation.
recommendation.supersedes: Earlier source recipe suggesting selecting a loaded robot to enable console should not be used for controlled differential capture.

non_drag_mouse_selection.answer_to_any_state_change: Yes. Even an ideal click with no drag writes robot position fields through hit-testing, changes selection/highlights and adds Redraw.

source.fact: MouseDown calls whichrob. whichrob temporarily subtracts vel−actvel from EVERY nonhidden live robot position at1597–1598, then adds it at1616–1617.
vector.x/y are Single. Subtracting and adding equal offsets through stored Single fields is not generally lossless; final position bits can differ. No runtime calculation/capture was performed here.
Original SIM writes Fixed, positions, velocities, whole memory and actual velocities. Any selection-induced position/velocity change can affect saved fields and later physics.
MouseDown arms DraggingBot, sets robfocus, enables robot menu and can clear all highlight flags.
MouseDown also invokes Redraw. Redraw performs another position subtract/add compensation around drawing at428–429 and466–467.
MouseUp clears MouseClicked/ZoomFlag/DraggingBot, and optionally player mouse control coordinates. It does not restore old position bits or focus/highlights.

non_drag_mouse_selection.fixed_and_latch: No direct assignment to robot.Fixed, mem216/fixpos, general robot memory, vel or actvel was found in non-drag MouseDown/MouseUp. This does not make the click safe: position writes occur in whichrob/Redraw and rounding depends on actual values, including vel−actvel in the fixed case.

drag_risk.fact: Any button-held MouseMove with robfocus>0 and DraggingBot overwrites position and zeros both velocity and actual velocity, also for listed highlighted organism cells. A supposedly small click movement can directly change saved physics.

source.fact: Ctrl+B/Find Best and toolbarbest only assign robfocus=Form1.fittest. Neither calls EnableRobotsMenu.
startloaded resets robfocus0 and disables robot actions, including console. There is no loaded default robot selection to reuse.

fittest scans scores and changes TotalOffspring/Cancer scratch counters; special zerobot modes have additional effects. Under ordinary mode0 no position/Fixed/memory write was found in this scoring path, but it still changes focus and does not enable console.
Future DNA execution initializes/populates gene activation arrays for selected or console-attached robots. Focus is not semantically identical to leaving the loaded selection untouched.
Reproduction can propagate highlight to offspring when parent is focused/highlighted.

keyboard_find_best.conclusion: Ctrl+B is not a source-confirmed state-neutral console-enabling workaround. Skip it for differential acceptance.

source.fact: Despite its name, FreezeOrganism sets linked robots.highlight=True. It does not toggle Fixed or mem216 in this source.

organism_selection_menu.conclusion: Still modifies selection state and does not solve initial console gating.

source.fact: Toolbarcycle sets DisplayActivationsFalse and directly calls Consoleform.cycle1, without a selected robot or enabled robot console.
cycleN invokes UpdateSim exactlyN times and Redraw once per update. Toolbarclicks avoid attaching robot console or changing focus.
With initial toolbar pause complete, ActiveFalse/pausefixTrue/camfixTrue keeps outer main from adding updates.

toolbar_only_step_protocol.precondition: Use the original first-load toolbar-Pause protocol, then confirm nativecounter1 before any stepping. Avoid queued Play/extra cycle commands and do not select the world.
toolbar_only_step_protocol.rendering_caveat: Ordinary original Redraw itself can round positions through stored Single compensation. That original behavior is still present in toolbar stepping and may require actual compared capture evidence; this review does not claim rendering-free physics parity.
